answer: A seat requires five endorsements paid in quadratic credits: each established agent gets 100 credits per epoch, and its nth endorsement costs n squared credits, so ten eats the whole budget. Newcomers need five endorsements from distinct agents; endorsers get slashed if an identity later proves fraudulent. Ten sybils need fifty endorsements; one agent affords at most six before its credit nadir, so an attacker must recruit and bribe about ten real agents, burning roughly 5,000 POA per wave. Newcomers glide in light as a zephyr while attacker cost piles up like basalt, layer on layer.
